What We Do

Core Capabilities

From prototype to production, Gord Industrial delivers precision molded components to specification — on time, every time.

Thermoplastic Molding

High precision thermoplastic injection molding for complex geometries, tight tolerances, and demanding production environments across multiple industries.

Thermoset Molding

Thermoset injection molding for applications requiring superior heat resistance, dimensional stability, and long term durability under demanding conditions.

Mold Making

In-house mold design and fabrication capability supporting rapid development cycles and precision tooling for both prototype and production volumes.

Medical Components

Precision molded components for medical device applications, produced with the quality controls and material traceability that critical healthcare applications demand.

Quality Assurance

Rigorous quality systems and documented inspection processes ensuring every part meets specification. Material traceability and process documentation available.

Custom Solutions

Engineering support for custom part development, material selection, and design for manufacturability. Rapid prototyping partnerships available for design validation prior to tooling commitment. From concept through production — one partner, complete solution.

Our Story

Six Decades of Manufacturing Excellence

Founded in 1961, Gord Industrial Plastics has spent over six decades building a reputation for precision, reliability, and manufacturing integrity in the heart of northern Illinois.

When a devastating facility fire threatened to end that legacy, Gord Industrial made the decision to rebuild — completely. A state of the art facility, all new equipment, and an unwavering commitment to the quality standards that built the business in the first place.

Today Gord Industrial operates from a modern, fully equipped production facility in Sandwich, Illinois, running exclusively Arburg injection molding equipment — among the most precise and reliable machines in the industry.

"We didn't want to go out like that." — James F. Gord, President
01

Our Equipment

Arburg Allrounder Fleet

Gord Industrial runs exclusively Arburg injection molding equipment — the gold standard in precision plastics manufacturing worldwide.

Arburg is a family-owned German manufacturer considered among the premier injection molding machine producers in the world. Their Allrounder series is renowned for precision, repeatability, and longevity — making them the equipment of choice for medical, automotive, electronics, and technical component manufacturers globally.

Operating an exclusively Arburg fleet — including Golden Edition hydraulic and all-electric EDrive models up to 220 tons — means every part produced at Gord Industrial benefits from the same level of precision and process consistency, regardless of size, complexity, or material.
